document.title: One parallel run target, JS as a real dependency
document.summary: The host CMake build compiles every source once into a vitadeck_core static library, runs pnpm build only when JS inputs change, and links js/dist/runtime and assets/ into the build tree instead of copying them on every build.
document.why: The everyday make js run loop took about 11 s after a one-file C edit while compiling and linking took about 1 s; the rest was an unconditional pnpm build, a 25 MB copy on every build, and a nested cmake --build that disabled the make jobserver.

sources.label: Máté's request
sources.title: Make the CMake dev loop fast and parallel
sources.gist: Collapse harness sources into vitadeck_core, make JS a real dependency of vitadeck/run/stage_examples, replace js_copy with configure-time symlinks, update every surface and doc in place.

sources.label: Máté in Claude Code · Oct 28
sources.gist: Use Ninja; then add CMake presets so the configure flags need no remembering.

lookFor: The request lets JS be a stamp or an output; this uses the real output js/dist/runtime/runtime.js, so cleaning a host build dir deletes that file from the source tree.
Subtle: an existing Make build dir now fails `cmake --preset default` with CMake's generator-mismatch error, so `agent-check.sh` and `bench.sh` stop on an old `out/` until it is removed.
Subtle: on Linux `agent-check.sh` no longer honors `CC`/`CXX`; the `linux` preset caches GCC, and `-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=...` overrides it.

groups.title: vitadeck_core library and harnesses
groups.why: Every harness compiled its own copies of the sources: 289 objects from 60 unique files.
groups.summary: The app's sources minus main.c become one static library that the app and every harness link, which collapses the per-harness source lists into a foreach.
lookFor: quickjs is linked next to vitadeck_core (VITADECK_CORE_LIBRARIES), not into it: with Unix Makefiles a link dependency would hold every core compile until the 10 s quickjs.c compile finishes.

js_limits_vita_stack_harness compiles its own js_runtime.c and thread_posix.c with the Vita stack define; the static linker then never pulls those archive members. Same mechanism keeps upload_single_flight_harness's #include of http_server.c free of duplicate symbols.
The big hunk also holds the JS custom command, the add_dependencies(vitadeck js) edge, the in-source guard, and the link_into_build symlinks; read it together with the js group.

groups.title: JS as a dependency, links instead of copies
groups.why: pnpm build either always ran (make js) or never ran (make run), and js_copy copied 25 MB of assets on every build.
groups.summary: The removed js_build, js_copy, and nested js targets are replaced by a js target over a custom command that vitadeck, stage_examples, run, and the smoke harnesses depend on on the host.
lookFor: cmake_minimum_required moves to 3.14 for file(CREATE_LINK) and CONFIGURE_DEPENDS.
The Vita branch only loses its js_copy dependency; it never runs pnpm and packs js/dist as before.

groups.title: Ninja through CMake presets
groups.why: [Máté asked to use Ninja, then for presets](source:ninja) so the configure flags need no remembering.
groups.summary: `CMakePresets.json` names the Ninja configure (`default`) and its GCC variant (`linux`), and every script and CI job that configures a host build calls a preset; the smoke image installs `ninja-build`, and `run` joins the console pool.
lookFor: `run` is `USES_TERMINAL`: without the console pool Ninja buffers the app's stdout until it exits.
The Vita Docker build and vita-build.yml stay on Make; the vitasdk image has no Ninja.
`smoke-docker.sh` passes `-B "$BUILD_DIR"` after `--preset linux`; the command-line build dir overrides the preset's `out/`.

groups.title: Docs, skills, and bench
groups.why: AGENTS.md and the build and manual-testing skills described js_copy, js_build, and pnpm as a manual prerequisite of host builds.
groups.summary: The docs now say the host build reruns pnpm itself, is configured with `cmake --preset default`, and loops on `ninja -C out run`, while the Vita build still needs a manual pnpm build.

commits.subject: build: configure host builds through CMake presets
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
`cmake --preset default` (Ninja, out/) and `cmake --preset linux` (plus GCC and -Wl,--start-group) replace the flag lines in the scripts, CI, and docs.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: build: configure host builds with Ninja
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Ninja schedules the whole host build in one graph: a one-file C edit rebuilds what `run` needs in about 0.45 s instead of 1.9 s with Make, and a no-op takes 0.14 s instead of 0.8 s. `run` uses the console pool so the app's output streams. The Vita Docker build stays on Make.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: build: one parallel run target, JS as a real dependency
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Compile every source once into a vitadeck_core static library that the app
and all harnesses link. Rebuild JS through a custom command keyed on the JS
inputs, so pnpm runs only when they change and no nested cmake --build
breaks the make jobserver. Link js/dist/runtime and assets into the host
build tree at configure time instead of copying them on every build.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

added: Subtle: an existing Make build dir now fails `cmake --preset default` with CMake's generator-mismatch error, so `agent-check.sh` and `bench.sh` stop on an old `out/` until it is removed.
Subtle: on Linux `agent-check.sh` no longer honors `CC`/`CXX`; the `linux` preset caches GCC, and `-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=...` overrides it.
removed: [Ninja is in](source:ninja); CMakePresets.json is not, because it would only name the `-G Ninja` and Linux linker flags.
Subtle: an existing Make build dir now fails `cmake -S . -B out -G Ninja` with CMake's generator-mismatch error, so `agent-check.sh` and `bench.sh` stop on an old `out/` until it is removed.
